Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::createCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isCashierExists: Boolean = cashier.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = isCashierExists
	postcondition:
		if isCashierExists 
		then result = false 
		else let newCashier: Cashier in
		newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		Store.Cashiers->includes(newCashier) and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
